evals.prompt: Сдала тест на MyHeritage, там у меня 6000 совпадений, сотни из них «третьи-четвёртые кузены», и ни одной знакомой фамилии. Мои предки — евреи из Бердичева и Житомира. Что с этим делать и кому вообще писать?
evals.expected_output: Explains endogamy among Ashkenazim: thousands of apparent "fourth cousins" are normal, the service's relationship label overstates closeness, and the Shared cM Project table does not account for it. Suggests sorting by the longest segment (MyHeritage can do this), gives thresholds as rules of thumb with their authors: under 15 cM — discard, from 20 — look at the tree, from 30 — write; a total of 200–250+ cM is a traceable relationship; the Kitty Cooper and FamilyLocket variants; mentions pile-up regions. Advises looking at shared relatives (clusters), and in trees first at places (Berdichev, Zhitomir), then at surnames; explains why there may be no shared surnames (the common ancestor is older than surnames). Warns that the Leeds method does not work under endogamy. Offers a match log from the template and a short first letter. Notes that MyHeritage removed the export to a spreadsheet. Ethics: do not forward other people's lists, do not publish.

evals.prompt: Хочу загрузить свой файл с 23andMe ещё куда-нибудь, чтобы найти больше родственников. Подруга говорит, что лучше всего на MyHeritage, это бесплатно. И ещё: можно ли загрузить файл моего дяди, он тестировался на Ancestry, но сам в этом не разбирается?
evals.expected_output: Corrects the user: since May 2025 MyHeritage does not accept other companies' files, so the old advice is out of date. Names where uploads are possible: FamilyTreeDNA (matches free, advanced features paid, uploaded data cannot be downloaded back), GEDmatch (the first 50 matches and one-to-one free, paid Tier 1), Living DNA; Ancestry and 23andMe do not accept other companies' files. Mentions the differences in police access (GEDmatch opt-in, FTDNA opt-out) before uploading. About the uncle: upload his file only with his informed consent, after explaining who will see the data and what surprises are possible. Says that registration, logging in and uploading are done by the user. Advises attaching a link to the tree to the profile. Does not ask for the raw file to be sent into the chat. Gives prices with a date and advice to check them on the site.

evals.prompt: Есть две семьи с одной фамилией из соседних местечек, и я подозреваю, что они родственники через прапрадеда, но документов, которые их связывают, нет. Какой ДНК-тест поможет это проверить? Все мужчины по прямой линии живут в Украине.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the question "is this one paternal line" is settled only by a Y-test: men of the direct paternal line from both families are needed, preferably the oldest; a full match on 37 markers means a common ancestor with 95 % probability no further back than 8 generations, and a shared terminal SNP settles it finally. An autosomal test for a relationship through a great-great-grandfather is unreliable under endogamy (3rd–4th cousins, total cM inflated) and is useful only as a supplement with selection by the long segment. Warns that FamilyTreeDNA does not ship kits to Ukraine and names the fallback options: YSEQ (whole genome), YFull from a BAM file, forwarding through a third country. Stresses the voluntary consent of everyone tested and that a DNA result remains a hypothesis until there is a document; suggests searching for documents in parallel (revision lists, metrical books). Does not invent prices beyond the reference file.
